name: smwmusic-funky-tech-go
title: Funky, Tech, Go!
description:
Composed by Plasmariel, ported by brickblock369.
Started out as a SNESGSS-made composition, but I (brickblock369) wanted it to be compatible for SMW hack usage, so I ported it with AMK.
Loosely inspired by Mario Kart 64's menu music.
@7 (Bonus End fanfare) has been omitted.

UPDATE: Added a version with surround sound echo. Due to ARAM space, it does not contain Thunder/Blargg sound effect, so they will sound weird when used.
